name: Guinness
source: NGX filing library, Guinness Nigeria Plc statement to the Exchange on the audited results for the 18 months ended 31 December 2025 (NGN thousands, as printed). Source prints Cost of sales signed for the 18-month column and unsigned for the 12-month column; both are stored as printed. Operating Expenses is marketing plus distribution plus administrative expenses. Income Tax is stored so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals the printed profit for the period: FY2024 was a loss year and the filing shows a tax credit of 18,913,093, stored as negative. | CRON 20261001: Revenue FY2025 corrected 730,803,355 to 730,808,355 thousand, the figure the audited FY2025 statement prints: the row's own identity only ties with the corrected value (Revenue less Cost of Sales must equal the stored Gross Profit 230,481,949). EPS row added from the same statement, basic and diluted, in kobo (1,879 FY2025; -2,500 FY2024), matching the kobo convention of the other NGN files
source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47517_GUINNESS_NIG_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them.
